text:
rachel: Kicking off remediation sprint for the repeated missing-span / bad-aggregation incidents. Need clear owners and short timelines so we can stop the quarterly recurrence.

ops-bot: Related postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-span-aggregation-drift - tasks created.

tom: short summary from infra: pattern -> exporter upstream 503s during bursts; aggregator sees partial emits then duplicates on retry window.

li: quick reproducer logs attached:
```
2026-03-24T02:11:02Z ingest[shard-3] WARN kv_cache: eviction spike=0.42
2026-03-24T02:11:03Z exporter ERROR write failed status=503 id=batch_98
2026-03-24T02:11:05Z aggregator INFO window=2026-03-24T02:11 emitted=1.25 expected=1.00
```

oscar: thanks. propose splitting into three workstreams: exporter hardening, aggregator correctness, ETL+backfill.

rachel: agree. propose owners: exporter -> tom, aggregator -> li, ETL/backfill -> oscar. Can we get volunteers?

tom: I will own exporter hardening. Plan: 1) dedupe middleware with idempotency token, 2) bounded retry queue with jittered backoff, 3) metric `exporter_dedupe_hits`. Target: design in 72h, canary in 10 days.

li: I will own aggregator correctness. Plan: 1) add ingest-window watermarking to avoid double-window writes, 2) introduce `emit_window_ratio` alert if >1.03 for 5m, 3) aggregator-lite route for degraded mode. Target: PRs in 7 days, rollout in 14.

oscar: I'll own ETL/backfill and runbook. Plan: 1) backfill detection job to surface windows with >1.05x, 2) safe re-emit utility, 3) customer impact report generation. ETA: detection job results in 3 business days.

qa: I'll add integration tests that simulate exporter 503s and assert no aggregate multiplier >1.01. Will coordinate test matrix with tom & li. ETA: 5 days.

rachel: good. For low-latency Dedicated tenants we must avoid global locks. tom use per-exporter short-lived dedupe cache (TTL 90s). li keep aggregator consistency checks async.

tom: noted. plan is per-exporter cache keyed by (batch_id, exporter_instance). metrics emitted: dedupe_hits, dedupe_misses, dedupe_evictions.

li: for degraded routing, suggestion: `smart-router` rule to route non-critical customers to `aggregator-lite` when `exporter_retry_rate` > 50 in 1m. oscar can you document which customers are non-critical?

oscar: will prepare a list and include in runbook. also adding a mitigation toggle in ops console.

rachel: backlog IDs: REM-4702 exporter dedupe (tom), REM-4703 exporter retry policy (tom), REM-4704 aggregator watermark + alert (li), REM-4705 backfill detection (oscar), REM-4706 canary CI tests (qa), REM-4707 ops degraded-route toggle (oscar). Please add acceptance criteria in each ticket.

ops-bot: Tasks created: REM-4702 REM-4703 REM-4704 REM-4705 REM-4706 REM-4707.

li: note about recurrence: this is the fourth similar incident in 6 months but now frequency is increasing. we should monitor recurrence-rate metric weekly for the next quarter.

rachel: tentative checkpoints: design docs for TOM/LI by 1769570000 (3 days), PRs opened by 1769990000 (10 days), detection job results by 1769750000 (5 days), CI test merged by 1769600000 (5 days). Everyone ok?

tom: confirm.

li: confirm.

oscar: confirm, starting job now.

qa: confirm, will smoke test in canary before merge.

rachel: I'll run a short weekly 15min sync until all REM tasks are closed. Next check-in: 1769530000 (48h). Postmortem will be updated with owners/timelines.

oscar: one ask - can we add an automated weekly sweep that flags shards with `kv_cache_eviction_rate > 0.3`? that correlates to spikes.

li: yes, adding to monitoring playbook.

qa: ping @security - any compliance concerns for re-emits?

security: policy review required for re-emits to customer data; oscar pls loop us in.

oscar: will include security review step in REM-4705.

rachel: thanks all. close the loop by updating the REM tickets and post progress in this thread.
